div.div:
Paths
The runner and every cluster call the load balancer origin, server.public_url: /api/v1 for the scenarios, /worker/v1 and /state/v1 for workers. Signed object URLs are GCS V4 signed URLs that Pods fetch from GCS directly.

text.tspan: The runner and every cluster call the load balancer origin, server.public_url:
/api/v1 for the scenarios, /worker/v1 and /state/v1 for workers. Signed
object URLs are GCS V4 signed URLs that Pods fetch from GCS directly.

div.div:
Trust anchors and egress
Everyone trusts system roots: the Google-managed certificate on the lab domain and the GCS endpoint. Each cluster egresses through its own NAT. The service account signs its own URLs and signs in to Cloud SQL with IAM.

div.div:
For
Managed services with no hosts: Cloud SQL IAM authentication, Cloud KMS keys and V4 signed URLs exercise the Google drivers end to end.

div.div:
Against
Cloud Run pulls only through Artifact Registry, and the scheduler needs CPU always allocated with fixed instances. The managed certificate needs a domain and time to provision. Remote server coverage needs its own collection.
